think_procedure.step_1: Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values in PostgreSQL.
think_procedure.step_2: Check whether it is a numerical knob (integer/float) with an inherent ordering.
think_procedure.step_3: If numerical, check for sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto) rather than just scaling behavior.
think_procedure.step_4: If the knob is boolean or enum (non-numerical), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition; classify as not a special knob under this definition.
think_procedure.step_5: Return classification and any special value(s) if applicable.
